projectScope: Prolific Capital GHL Pipeline — Kayla/Montelli REI Operations

OUTREACH_DAYS.rule: No prospect outreach on Saturday or Sunday.
OUTREACH_DAYS.classification: Monday–Friday availability and Saturday/Sunday prohibition are OWNER_POLICY. No original course transcript explicitly defines prospect SMS days. Existing weekend-block implementation is TECHNICAL_DEFAULT aligned to OWNER_POLICY.

OUTREACH_HOURS.rule: Prospect SMS window is Monday through Friday, 12:00 PM through 6:00 PM.

endBoundary.description: 12:00:00 PM is allowed. 5:59:59 PM is allowed. 6:00:00 PM and later is blocked.

testRequirements: Old 10 AM default no longer governs

TIMEZONE_POLICY.rule: The 12:00 PM–6:00 PM window uses the property's local timezone derived from the full property address ZIP code.
TIMEZONE_POLICY.implementation: Full 5-digit ZIP → timezone mapping with ZIP3-level precision. Multi-zone states use ZIP3-level resolution. Unknown or ambiguous timezone blocks production.
TIMEZONE_POLICY.dayRendering: [day] in the INT template is rendered using the same property-local timezone that controls the send window.
testRequirements: Florida panhandle and Eastern Florida resolve correctly
Day rendering uses same timezone as business-time validation

WEEKEND_OVERRIDE.rule: Weekend sending has no ad-hoc conversational override. No MANUAL_LIVE_ALLOWED bypass. No kill-switch state bypass.
testRequirements: Kill-switch state does not bypass weekend

PLAN_EXPIRATION.rule: A canary plan expires on the earliest of: configured absolute TTL, end of valid business window, change of local day, policy version change, template version change, opportunity/contact change, stage/status change, new inbound reply, suppression/opt-out change, prior-outreach change, sender/provider readiness change, or selection mutation. Sunday plan cannot be held for Monday. Every regeneration requires new plan ID, new hash, fresh rendered weekday, fresh guards, and new explicit approval.

INT_TEMPLATE_VARIANT.rule: The owner-approved production INT rendering is: 'Happy [day], [Name]! Are you still accepting offers for [address]? My name is [your name], I'm looking to purchase this as a rental for my portfolio.'
INT_TEMPLATE_VARIANT.provenance: OWNER_POLICY — explicitly approved project variant derived from the owner's operating preference. Combines the 'Happy [day]' greeting from the SELLER_INITIAL call script (AIREI_MASTER_PLAYBOOK.md line 157) with the INT shortcut body. It is not Kayla's original SMS wording. The original course INT (COURSE_CANONICAL_INT) has no greeting and is preserved separately for audit.
testRequirements: Owner-approved INT renders exact text with punctuation

SENDER_LOCK.rule: The approved Pipeline sender is the 571 number ending 2619.

CANARY_LIMIT.rule: Maximum initial production canary size is 3 records.

APPROVAL.rule: Every production send requires an immutable plan and explicit owner approval.

DNC_STOP.rule: DNC, STOP, and opt-out contacts must never receive outreach. Unknown DNC/STOP state must block, not pass. Absence of a GHL tag is not affirmative clearance.
testRequirements: Positive clear from every required source passes
Absence of GHL tag alone does not pass

PENDING_REPLY.rule: Before first INT: NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_PRIOR_CONTACT. After INT sent: WAITING_FOR_REPLY (BLOCK until resolved). Unknown pending-reply state must block.

ACTIVE_HUMAN_WORK.rule: Manual release only. No automatic timeout. If operator-locked → BLOCKED. If not locked → CLEAR.

PRIOR_OUTREACH.rule: Fresh Lead Entered with no evidence of prior contact: CLEAR_NO_PRIOR_OUTREACH. Evidence-backed previous outreach: BLOCKED. Unknown prior-outreach state must block.

DUPLICATE_HISTORY.rule: Duplicate contacts or properties must not receive duplicate outreach. Unknown duplicate state must block.

CONTACT_PATH.rule: No outreach until contact path is established. Unresolved role/contact path must block.

PROVIDER_UNCERTAINTY.rule: Provider uncertainty must block execution. No automatic retries after uncertain result.

RETRY_POLICY.rule: No automatic retries after an uncertain provider result.

GHL_WRITES.rule: No automatic GHL note, task, field, workflow, or contact write during the initial SMS canary.

STAGE_MOVEMENT.rule: No automatic GHL stage movement during the initial SMS canary.

PROJECT_ISOLATION.rule: Divinity CRM is a separate project and must never influence this Pipeline.
testRequirements: Divinity CRM excluded from Pipeline context
